quantities.definition: Change in the archived spread (SPEC-A sign convention) between two declared archived captures of the same game.
quantities.resolution_timing: At the later of the two declared captures; final at T1 (last archived capture before kickoff).

quantities.definition: Rushing plays as a fraction of a team's total offensive plays (rush attempts / (rush attempts + pass attempts)), sacks excluded.
Sacks taken as a fraction of a quarterback's dropbacks (sacks / (pass attempts + sacks)).
Seconds per play in neutral situations (win probability between 0.2 and 0.8, excluding the final two minutes of each half).
Total turnovers committed by a team (interceptions thrown + fumbles lost).
Total penalty yards assessed against a team.
A named player's official game-day inactive/active status.
quantities.resolution_timing: At official inactives publication (approximately 90 minutes before kickoff).

quantities.definition: A team's scoring margin within a single declared quarter (points for minus points against in that quarter).
quantities.resolution_timing: At the end of the declared quarter.

rule: AFFECTED must name a quantity in this registry. New quantities enter only by a registry version bump.
